data.name: Acoustic Guitar
data.description: A playable acoustic guitar used to attract ARC's attention, and impress other Raiders.
data.article:
The Acoustic Guitar is an instrument used to play melodies, which can attract nearby ARCs. Other Raiders can also play along with instruments such as the Recorder or Shaker. While playing, actions that require both hands are not possible.

  • It can be purchased from Shani for 70 coins, with a limit of one per day.
  • One is obtained upon completing the project Trophy Display.
  • It is also found on page 3 of Decks: Raider Deck AR/RD 002: Goalie.

data.description: The Hairpin wastes very little motion between shots. That sort of efficiency gets more interesting once a scope is involved.

data.name: Adrenaline Shot
data.description: A serum that fully restores stamina and temporarily increases stamina regeneration.
data.article:
The Adrenaline Shot is a quick-use item that completely restores your stamina and temporarily makes it regenerate faster. This helps you keep moving or use stamina-draining abilities more often when you need to.

These shots can be found by scavenging in the environment, crafted at a Medical Lab or with the In-Round Crafting skill, or purchased from Lance for 900 coins.

data.name: Advanced ARC Powercell
data.description: Very valuable resource that drops from certain ARC enemies.
data.article:
The Advanced ARC Powercell is a resource item scavenged from ARCs like the Bastion, Courier, and Sentinel.

It is used in crafting various supplies at Workbench and Medical Lab. This item can also be recycled to gain other resources.

component.name: ARC Powercell
component.description: Valuable resource that drops from all ARC enemies.

arc.name: Leaper
arc.description: This isn't just an ARC; it's a massive, arachnid-like siege engine. Its heavy armor gives it a hulking, near-indestructible presence on the battlefield, but don't mistake its bulk for sluggishness. This mechanized spider possesses an unnerving, gravity-defying ability to leap vast distances. Reports confirm it has been seen clearing impossible gaps, even bounding effortlessly to the summit of a Spaceport tower. It's a vertical threat you can't simply hide from.

arc.name: Comet
arc.description:
Often found guarding heavy machines, the Comet serves as a brutal deterrent against Raiders who attempt flanking tactics. When it acquires a target it accelerates with alarming speed, and triggers its self-destruct once it's near enough to guarantee damage.

Its blast radius is generous and unforgiving, as grouped-up squads have learned the hard way. Its armor plating protects its core, but it opens up when it charges, exposing its vulnerable innards. However, even when exposed, hitting such a fast-moving weak spot requires a particularly skilled trigger finger.

Experienced Raiders treat the Comet as a priority target, dropping it before engaging whatever it's protecting. The alternative is fighting a Bastion while a live bomb circles for an opening. Shani suspects ARC deployed them specifically in response to Raider flanking tactics - another sign that the machines are learning

arc.name: ARC Turbine
arc.description: A volatile machine that wreaks relentless havoc on the impulsive and uncoordinated.

arc.name: Bastion
arc.description: A massive, heavily armored ARC unit, built around a terrifying, fully automatic minigun. It rarely moves without air support overhead, which helps it pin down and suppress Raider movement. Listen for its loud, distinct screech—that's your warning before it unleashes a three-second hail of bullets toward the last known enemy position.

arc.name: Rocketeer
arc.description: This is a formidable flying ARC, a pure engine of destruction that dominates the airspace. It poses a significant threat not just because it flies, but because of its powerful rocket attacks and devastating focus on area-of-effect (AoE) damage. This unit is designed to saturate an area, turning cover into a liability and forcing Raiders to constantly relocate or be wiped out by the sheer force of its explosions. Treat it like a mobile artillery piece—it hits hard and wide.

arc.name: Matriarch
arc.description: The head of the Family. This ARC shoots rockets, gas and has big shield. She will also spawn her Leapers, Bastions, Fireballs, Hornets and Wasps.

arc.name: Queen
arc.description:
This is the Goliath of the ARC forces, a colossal machine whose presence defines the battlefield. It is only deployed during the critical Harvester Event, acting as the immovable guardian of the Harvester unit. Its incredible durability and lethal arsenal make it the single greatest threat on the map; attempting to scratch its armor alone is a fool's errand—you'll need a full squad of Raiders working in concert just to stand a chance.

Its attacks are devastating:

Mortar Barrage: The dome atop the unit launches three massive mortars that land in a cluster around a targeted Raider. Two seconds after impact, they detonate in a fiery, engulfing inferno.

Sustained Laser: It periodically sweeps its primary weapon, firing a continuous laser beam at any Raider it acquires in its line-of-sight.

Close-Quarters Deterrents: Should Raiders try to get up close and personal, the Goliath switches modes, delivering either a disruptive EMP pulse to shut down technology or a crushing ground slam to obliterate anything nearby.

arc.name: Sentinel
arc.description:
A large unarmored turret that sits atop buildings and ledges. Often found outside and usually very high up. Contains a small vulnerable capsule attached to its swiveling arm.

Traces movement and will fire off a single Heavy round every 5 seconds while having line-of-sight on a Raider.

arc.name: ARC Surveyor
arc.description: This is the largest of the rolling ARCs, a massive, spherical construct designed to dominate open ground. Its primary tactic is to stop periodically on the battlefield to transmit disruptive signals, acting as a massive relay for the ARC network. Be warned, however, its most unique (and dangerous) trait is its resilience: as it takes damage, its outer shell breaks apart into many smaller, armored pieces. Its final attack is a relentless one: it will roll directly at high speed toward any Raider it detects, essentially turning itself into a giant, high-impact bowling ball.

arc.name: Bombardier
arc.description: The Bombardier is an armored ARC that functions as heavy, mobile artillery. Its movement is slow and loud. Armed with a multi-rocket launcher, it unleashes devastating, long-range barrages that can obliterate your entire squad. Do not engage this unit. If you hear its grinding approach, silence your movement and escape the area immediately, as its attention is a death sentence.

arc.name: Vaporizer
arc.description: The Vaporizer is a large, airborne ARC machine, which quickly gained notoriety among Raiders for its devastating lasers and volatile, unpredictable attack patterns.

data.name: Advanced Mechanical Components
data.description: Used to craft advanced weapons. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article:
Advanced Mechanical Components are a refined material primarily used for crafting and upgrading items. They support your weapon crafting at the Gunsmith in your Hideout, enabling the creation of various advanced weapons and high-end components.

  • You can find this item by defeating specific ARCs such as the Queen.
  • It can also be looted from various containers or environmental spots during your raids.
  • Another way is to craft it yourself at a Refiner using other materials.

This item can be recycled for resources.

data.name: Agave
data.description: A piece of an agave leaf. Can be used to regain a small amount of health.
data.article: Agave is an uncommon healing item that helps Raiders regain a small amount of health over time when consumed. It can be found by harvesting agave plants in the Dam Battlegrounds map and the outskirts of the Buried City map. Raiders can also scavenge for it inside wicker baskets. This item can also be used to craft healing supplies.

data.description: A concoction that temporarily increases stamina regeneration, at a small initial cost to health.
data.article: Agave Juice is a consumable item that Raiders can use to temporarily increase their stamina regeneration, while taking a small amount of health damage at the start. This helps Raiders quickly regain stamina during raids and it can only be crafted in-raid.

data.name: Air Freshener
data.description: May be worth a few coins.
data.article: The Air Freshener is a trinket that Raiders collect. Its primary role is to be sold for coins, offering a simple way to earn funds during your raids. This item also has a secondary use as a crafting component: it can be combined with other materials to create crafted items, a process that takes place directly during an active raid. You can obtain it by thoroughly searching the environment and looting various containers.

data.name: Alarm Clock
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Alarm Clock is a resource Raiders can find by searching and looting within residential areas throughout the various maps. Its main use is to be recycled for basic crafting materials, which are helpful for crafting new gear or upgrading existing items at a crafting workbench in your Hideout.

data.name: Alien Duck
data.description: A long, long way from home.
data.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
data.article: The Alien Duck is a decorative item, a variant of the Rubber Duck. It serves to personalize your Raider Den in your Hideout, or you can throw it to create noise, which can be used as a distraction. You can obtain this item by scavenging inside chimneys when the "Bird City" event is active. Other similar collectible duck variants include the Doodly Duck, Familiar Duck, Flashy Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck.
